§6Conveyors§f

§aThe dumbest, cheapest way to move items. And honestly, sometimes that's exactly what you need.§f

Conveyor Belts transport items between machines. They pick up dropped items or items from ejectors and drop them at the end of the line if nothing grabs them. Items don't collide, so throughput is unlimited.

You've got four flavors: §bStandard§f (yellow), §bDouble-Lane§f (red, 3-wide for grabbers), §bTriple-Lane§f (purple, 3-wide with steel plates), and §bExpress§f (green, faster with Engine Lubricant).

For crafting, always use the §brubber recipe§f (3 rubber + 2 ingots = 64 belts). Leather and rope recipes exist but give way fewer belts for the same cost.

§ePS:§f Double-lane and triple-lane belts are mainly decorative unless you're using conveyor grabbers. Standard belts do the job for 99% of setups.
